calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-28-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/Gina Gonzales, CSR: Karla Davis.
Petitioner: Kai Ming Lo, present in pro per, as guardian ad litem for minor Cheuk Fai Lo, and with Cantonese interpreter: William Guan.
Co-petitioner/minor's mother Ching Yuk Kisa Lo Chan is not present but consented to the name change in the petition.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a minor to: Raymond Cheuk Fai Lo.
Decree signed in open court.
